lines.en: I fall asleep while walking

lines.zh: 我比杜高半个头，也更沉
lines.en: I stand half a head over Duu, and heavier
I don't walk; I drift over
My hem drags on the ground

lines.zh: 我一步一晃，像随时会倒
lines.en: I sway with each step, ready to topple
I rub my eyes and keep going
I lean off course into a fern

lines.zh: 我飞起来，为了少走几步
lines.en: I fly to save a few steps
I yawn my way over the roof
My fist rests on my hip

lines.zh: 我走到一半停住了，忘了去哪
lines.en: Halfway there I stop, forgetting the way
The ground softens under my steps
I fall asleep standing up
My snoring rolls in my nose
I sit and my head keeps nodding
A short sleep and my ki comes back
I put my hands behind my head

lines.zh: 我梦见了什么，笑了一下
lines.en: I dream something and smile
My breathing is slow and long
I open one eye, then close it
My feeler droops softly
I roll over and sleep on

lines.zh: 风把衣角掀起来，我不管
lines.en: Wind lifts my hem; I ignore it
This is a good place to sleep

lines.zh: 半梦半醒之间，我听见虫鸣
lines.en: Half asleep, I hear insects
How long have I slept now
I open my eyes and find you there
I size you up while yawning

lines.zh: 你在我睡觉的时候来的
lines.en: You came while I was asleep
I really don't want to get up
I've marked your ki

lines.zh: 我抬起一只手，算是招呼
lines.en: I lift a hand as a greeting

lines.zh: 你要是吵醒我，就不太好了
lines.en: If you wake me, that won't be nice
I squint, not fully awake
You're smaller than most I've met
I sit up slowly
Just woke up, and I'm still hungry.
Speak if you must; I'm listening
I touch my own face
Step back; I'm getting up

lines.zh: 我打呼的时候你就在了？
lines.en: Were you here while I snored
I don't dislike you, as it happens
You're a little warm

lines.zh: 我考虑一下要不要理你
lines.en: Let me consider whether to bother
I sway twice and steady
I touch where I was hit
Something rumbles deep in my throat

lines.zh: 我退了一步，衣摆拖在地上
lines.en: I step back, hem dragging
My ki skips half a beat
I frown, deeply displeased
I breathe out slowly through my nose
That hurt more than I expected
I look at you and my eyes change
Food; that woke me halfway
I smelled something sweet in my dream
Give it here; I'm still sleepy
I open my mouth with my eyes shut
That's not enough to settle my stomach
One more bite and I'll sleep again
I chew slowly, in no hurry
Bring the rest if there is any

lines.zh: 这点东西让我精神多了
lines.en: That perked me up considerably
You bump me and I sway
I'm too heavy for you to push

lines.zh: 我的衣摆缠住了你的脚
lines.en: My hem tangles your feet
Half asleep, I bump into you
You duck under my arm
The knock wakes me a little
I stepped on your foot; sorry

lines.zh: 我站着没动，你自己弹开了
lines.en: I don't move; you bounce off

lines.zh: 另一个身影在我旁边坐下
lines.en: Another shape sits down beside me
We sleep back to back
I give her half my spot
We snore side by side
Her ki is steady; it calms me
Neither of us wants to move
I block the wind for her

lines.zh: 睡着的时候，她的手搭过来
lines.en: Asleep, her hand comes to rest on me
When I wake, she's still there

lines.zh: 以后这地方有两个人睡
lines.en: Two of us sleep here now
I grab it, still half asleep
It's hard and digs into my palm
I lift it to look, then set it down
I tuck it in my sleeve and sleep on

lines.zh: 它掉在我肚子上，我醒了
lines.en: It lands on my belly and wakes me
I pinch it between two fingers
I sniff it; not interested
This could serve as a pillow
I flatten it without noticing
I'll keep it and look when I wake
You strike, and only then do I open my eyes
I've slept long enough; my ki is full
I stand, taller than you
That was a worthwhile sleep

lines.zh: 我最讨厌睡着时被人扰
lines.en: I hate being disturbed in my sleep
My fist closes
You've angered the awake me
I throw my hem back
Ki leaks off me in waves
Run if you want
Let me see what you can do
I'm used to sleeping here
Don't count on me taking it slow
The ground rang when I landed

lines.zh: 醒来第一件事就是打你
lines.en: First thing awake is hitting you
Your luck is truly bad today
I fix on you, hand already raised
A ki blast leaves my palm
You dodge; the second follows close
My ki wave presses the grass flat
I take to the air and follow
A burst barrage rains from above
I'm not fast, but I'm heavy

lines.zh: 你退到空地，我正好发力
lines.en: You retreat to open ground; good for me

lines.zh: 我每一下都往你的落脚点打
lines.en: I aim each shot where you'll land
Your ki is thinning
I'll add one more volley

lines.zh: 我打偏了，树被削掉一半
lines.en: I miss and shears half a tree
You circle; I don't chase
I wait for you to run into it
Blasts pock the ground with shallow pits
I've got this whole area covered
Don't stop; stopping gets you hit
I'm sleepy again; let's finish this

lines.zh: 我一拳砸下去，地面塌了一块
lines.en: I slam a fist and the ground caves

lines.zh: 我的拳头从侧面抡过来
lines.en: My fist swings in from the side
I leap and press down on you

lines.zh: 你挡住了，膝盖屈了一下
lines.en: You block and your knees bend
I strike three times in the air
My arm hooks your leg

lines.zh: 这一下把你打退了很远
lines.en: That one sends you far back
I land amid cracks
I ram your chest with my shoulder
You slip away; I catch only air

lines.zh: 我的拳打在你身后的树上
lines.en: My punch lands on the tree behind you
I turn and swing an elbow
A ki blast bursts behind my fist
Still standing; interesting
I take a breath and continue
This next one has to land
I sit up slowly from the ground
The snoring stops first

lines.zh: 我的影子比杜的大一圈
lines.en: My shadow is a size larger than Duu's
I open my eyes on this place

lines.zh: 我站起来，土从我身上落下
lines.en: I stand and earth falls off me

lines.zh: 空气里有一股厚重的气
lines.en: A heavy ki hangs in the air

lines.zh: 我仰头，打了个很大的哈欠
lines.en: I tip back my head for a huge yawn
When I land, the grass bows
This place suits sleeping, and fighting
I'm not fully awake yet
I reach out and touch something
I drift in from a distance
One step leaves a shallow pit

lines.zh: 我的气息把鸟都惊走了
lines.en: My presence scares the birds off
I look at you, then elsewhere
I seem to have forgotten why I came
I'm here; you may begin

lines.zh: 睡不着了，那就活动一下
lines.en: Can't sleep now; might as well move

lines.zh: 我被烫得跳起来，睡意全无
lines.en: The burn makes me jump, wide awake

lines.zh: 我摔下来，地面被我砸出坑
lines.en: I fall and crater the ground

lines.zh: 水进了我的肺，我咳不出来
lines.en: Water's in my lungs and I can't cough

lines.zh: 爆炸把我推得滑了出去
lines.en: The blast slides me backward
An arrow sticks in my arm
Magic locks my ki away
Hunger woke me; that's bad

lines.zh: 雷打在我背上，我弓起腰
lines.en: Lightning hits my back and I arch
No ground below; sleep is gone
